853:t_119:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Perfectly, Powerfully, Plumply OK! ...How about a comeback like that?」

853:t_119:15.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「And strike a pose, too! A wide stance for Perfectly, flexed muscles for Powerfully, and for Plumply, the chinpyorosupon~!」

853:t_119:17.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Now... join me! Perfectly, Powerfully, Plumply OK!」

853:t_119:19.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You've still got a long way to go, $n. Anyone who can't let go of themselves won't grasp anything from here on.」

853:t_119:20.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
(That's right... For the time will come when you must abandon everything.)

853:t_120:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As I thought, congratulating yourself is a little hollow...」

853:t_120:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「But I won't be discouraged! I want to praise myself for climbing all the way up to ace in this limited time!」

853:t_121:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「You're ignoring me!? I expected it, though...」

853:t_121:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Then, Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$渓$$ and Mr. $$凱$$!」

853:t_121:8.en:
$$凱$$
「We'll say thanks for $$號$$'s share too.」

853:t_121:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of the $$ゲッター$$ Team... Miss $$渓$$ and Mr. $$凱$$ make up for what Mr. $$號$$ lacks.」

853:t_121:10.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Mr. $$號$$ and Miss $$渓$$ join forces for a grand total of... $$號$$$$渓$$. How witty.」

853:t_121:11.en:
$$凱$$
「W-what about my place in all this!?」

853:t_122:4.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「As the one who leads $$チームＤ$$, I am obliged to do at least this much.」

853:t_122:5.en:
$$田中司令$$
「Well... that's what they call the dignity of an adult.」

853:t_122:6.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Thank you for your hard work too, Mr. $$田中$$.」

853:t_122:7.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I'm one of the staff supporting $$チームＤ$$, after all.」

853:t_122:8.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What a good opportunity. Please show Mr. $$田中$$ $$ダンクーガ$$'s traditional 'I'll Do It' series too!」

853:t_122:10.en:
$$田中司令$$
「I'll do it, and I'll go and do it, and I'll go on doing it and all that...」

853:t_122:11.en:
$$Ｆ．Ｓ．$$
「I heard it, the cry of your soul.」

853:t_123:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ブライト$$!」

853:t_123:4.en:
$$ブライト$$
「I suppose I managed to save face somehow.」

853:t_123:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「As expected of a Gundam-piloting pops! What a relaxed remark.」

853:t_123:6.en:
$$ブライト$$
「One troublesome son like $$ハサウェイ$$ is plenty for me.」

853:t_123:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「What would you do if that Mr. $$ハサウェイ$$ ended up piloting a newly designed Gundam someday?」

853:t_123:8.en:
$$ブライト$$
「Nothing. He's no longer a child, after all.」

853:t_123:9.en:
$$ブライト$$
「If he chose that himself, then from there on I'll deal with him as a man, not as a parent.」

853:t_123:11.en:
$$ブライト$$
「...Though I say that, in truth my feelings are still mixed.」

853:t_123:12.en:
$$ブライト$$
「To spare myself needless worry, let's end this battle quickly.」

853:t_123:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Understood! Let's seize the future with our own hands!」

853:t_124:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$オットー$$!」

853:t_124:4.en:
$$オットー$$
「Don't make such a fuss. I merely did my duty.」

853:t_124:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Magnificent, Mr. $$オットー$$. Somehow, compared to the $$時獄戦役$$, your face seems more composed.」

853:t_124:6.en:
$$オットー$$
「I can't tell for myself... What do you think, XO?」

853:t_124:7.en:
$$レイアム$$
「If I may speak out of turn, I think AG is right.」

853:t_124:8.en:
$$オットー$$
「Well... it's a compliment of sorts. I'll take it as encouragement.」

853:t_124:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「How refined, Mr. $$オットー$$! As a bonus prize, please enjoy this tea!」

853:t_124:10.en:
$$オットー$$
「Hmm... the astringency makes for a good flavor. Quite something.」

853:t_124:11.en:
$$レイアム$$
(I hope the Captain matures like that black tea.)

853:t_125:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Miss $$スメラギ$$!」

853:t_125:4.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「But this isn't thanks to my strength alone.」

853:t_125:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Congratulations to Mr. $$ラッセ$$, Miss $$フェルト$$ and Miss $$ミレイナ$$ as well!」

853:t_125:7.en:
$$ミレイナ$$
「Right! Usually we're sort of the unsung heroes.」

853:t_125:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「I've always thought it, but I envy Mr. $$ラッセ$$ for being on such a glamorous bridge.」

853:t_125:10.en:
$$スメラギ$$
「If you got as compact as $$ハロ$$, I might let you stay.」

853:t_125:12.en:
$$ラッセ$$
「That's how it is. Don't go dreaming too much about $$ソレスタルビーイング$$.」

853:t_126:3.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Happy Ace Pilot! Congratulations, Mr. $$ジェフリー$$!」

853:t_126:4.en:
$$ジェフリー$$
「Having been entrusted with the $$Ｓ．Ｍ．Ｓ$$, I have to show I can do at least this much.」

853:t_126:6.en:
$$キャシー$$
「The $$クォーター$$ is a Macross all the same, after all.」

853:t_126:7.en:
$$ミーナ#pt251$$
「We have to fight in a way worthy of that name...」

853:t_126:8.en:
$$ラム$$
「Or we'll become a laughingstock of the entire fleet.」

853:t_126:9.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「A bridge that's a garden of women... So this is a Macross tradition too.」

853:t_126:11.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「Yes! Mr. $$ボビー$$, a maiden at heart, please bloom suspiciously, like a rafflesia!」

853:t_126:12.en:
$$ボビー$$
「A man-eating flower is still a flower! I'll do my part for the $$クォーター$$'s flower garden!」

853:t_126:13.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That spirit...! What a fine woman you are, Mr. $$ボビー$$!」

853:t_127:5.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「That smile... truly an angel... Ah... if only I could lay these hands upon that lovely cheek...」

853:t_127:6.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Laying hands on our goddess will not be permitted.」

853:t_127:7.en:
$$ＡＧ$$
「M-Mr. $$マデューカス$$, why are you here!?」

853:t_127:8.en:
$$テッサ$$
「My victory is thanks to Mr. $$マデューカス$$. So naturally, I have him sit in on occasions like this.」

853:t_127:9.en:
$$マデューカス$$
「Precisely, AG. Now, praise the entire crew of the $$トゥアハー・デ・ダナン$$.」
